snippet.title: Living Room - Official Wild Style Update Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the latest Living Room trailer for the mixed reality eco-sim game to see what to expect with the Wild Style update. Transform your furniture to create vibrant ecosystems, complete quests, breed creatures, create a life-sized pet, customize your pet, and more. Living Room's Wild Style update will be available on Meta Quest on July 17, 2025.
